role_family: Engineering versus business and customer-facing hiring paths
focus_signals: Engineering-track candidates should expect a coding assessment; business and customer-facing tracks more often involve presentations or role walkthroughs.
Both paths are evaluated against the same stated values and use standard evaluation guides.
Within engineering, candidates can distinguish platform, product, forward-deployed, quality, cloud, and developer-productivity work.
Within customer-facing work, candidates can distinguish account executive, solution consulting, customer success, renewals, and digital sales paths.
